title: Justice Department announces results of scam crackdown: over 400 cases against over 800 defendants
date_note: The DOJ release is dated 24 November 2026 and gives no earlier day for the announcement.
geo_basis: the Department of Justice, Washington, DC, which issued the release
summary: The Justice Department announced results of a surge against criminal scam networks and online fraud that followed an executive order signed on March 6, 2026. It says prosecutors acted in over 400 cases against over 800 defendants, with 30 defendants extradited. It says US prosecutors and agents assisted raids on foreign scam call centers and compounds in over 10 countries. The release notes indictments are allegations.
plain: The US Justice Department says it brought over 400 cases against over 800 defendants in a surge against scam networks and online fraud, with 30 defendants extradited.
exec: The Justice Department reports over 400 cases against over 800 defendants in its scam crackdown, with 30 extraditions; indictments are allegations.

validation.note: DOJ's own release read; Bitcoin Magazine (read) relays the same announcement, including the 30 extraditions and over 10 countries.
